title: Close, but No Cigar
text: Close, but No Cigar. I have been hunting for a car air freshener for months that smells like leather.  I do not know what the issue is with car air fresheners but none actually smell like leather.  This is not a car freshener, but I put a few drops on a cardboard coaster to see if this would work.  Not a good leather smell and it is greasy.
